_readme: Per-run monitoring log, one file per calendar day (America/Phoenix), used to generate the Daily PDF Report. Distinct from cases.json, which is the permanent case/review-queue index.
_run_note: Fiftieth scheduled run. NO NEW FINDINGS: zero matches without an existing case across 8,690 product pages on 15 serving URLs. This is the first full pass with both of the 2026-11-19 fixes in place from the start, and it found nothing new -- which is the expected shape, since the trademark-symbol fix cleared its backlog in one run yesterday (43 cases, 39 of them TM titles at Redland Ranch). TWO COVERAGE GAPS, both reported and neither treated as clean. Xavian's Roses was refused again by its firewall, as on its first scheduled run. YOUR ROSES IS NEW TODAY and is not the September block: its site root answers HTTP 200 while every catalog path -- the REST feed, /wp-json/, the sitemap and /shop/ -- returns HTTP 404, where September was a 403 on those paths. A 404 on the sitemap and /shop/ too is broader than a firewall rule and may be a site change rather than a block; it is recorded as observed and not diagnosed further. 89 Your Roses cases went unchecked today and hold their dates.

Firewall closes the connection with no HTTP response to any request carrying the Rose Watch user-agent. Second consecutive scheduled run refused. Coverage gap; its 9 cases hold their 2026-11-18 Last Verified date. No workaround attempted.

Site root answered HTTP 200 but EVERY catalog path returned HTTP 404 -- /wp-json/, /wp-json/wp/v2/product, /sitemap_index.xml and /shop/. Server identifies as Hostinger's CDN (hcdn). This is NOT the 2026-09-18 block, which was HTTP 403 on the same paths; a 404 on the sitemap and /shop/ as well is broader than a firewall rule and may be a site change rather than a block. 89 cases were not checked and are not reported as present or removed; their Last Verified dates are held. Per the September precedent the crawler keeps making the same request each run and nothing is worked around.

screenshot_limitation: 466 of 516 cases carry a screenshot; 50 do not, unchanged from yesterday because no case was created today. The gaps are 44 High Garden (the seller blanks its pages for automated browsers; capturable only by the user), 3 Flower Meadow Dream (removed, HTTP 404, nothing left to photograph) and 3 One Love (membership login wall, not bypassed). Registered coverage is 84 of 88: HIGHGARDEN-011, -018 and -024, plus ONELOVEROS-002 behind that wall.
